keys.{cherry_spawn_sub}: The first bite takes the money
keys.{cherry_yours}: A golden cherry fell on your slice!
keys.{crown_other}: %s is the king of this cake
keys.{crown_you}: You are the king of this cake!
keys.{desc_bots}: %s bots sit at the table; the cake will have %s slices.
keys.{desc_diff_easy}: Rookie bots eat slowly and are clumsy shoppers.
keys.{desc_diff_hard}: Master bots press fast, steal slices and buy the right cards.
keys.{desc_diff_normal}: Normal bots eat at a steady pace and shop sensibly.
keys.{desc_mode_cakes}: The game ends after the chosen number of cakes. The last one is a giant wedding cake worth double points.
keys.{desc_mode_crowns}: Whoever eats the most of a cake gets its crown. The first to reach the target wins. Every cake is a new race.
keys.{desc_mode_time}: When time runs out, whoever ate the most wins. The final starts in the last minutes and every gram counts double. The clock stops while the market is open.
keys.{desc_pace}: It is a short game, so money flows %s times faster and the cakes are smaller.
keys.{gift}: A full slice came to you!
keys.{it_apprentice_d}: You eat by yourself 1.5 more bites per second.
keys.{it_bakery_d}: Earns money every second, even when you are not eating.
keys.{it_butler_d}: Buys permanent upgrades from the market for you whenever you can afford them.
keys.{it_cherry_magnet_d}: The golden cherry lands on your slice more often and pays more.
keys.{it_conveyor_d}: You eat by yourself 3 more bites per second.
keys.{it_fork_d}: You eat sponge and fruit 60% faster.
keys.{it_gold_spoon_d}: 25% faster on every layer, 15% more money.
keys.{it_guard_dog_d}: When someone tries to steal your slice, it pushes back for you.
keys.{it_hammer_d}: You crack ganache, caramel and pistachio 60% faster.
keys.{it_honey_sauce_d}: Pours a thick layer of honey on the slice in front of you.
keys.{it_hot_pepper_d}: The leader's stomach fills up at once.
keys.{it_knife_d}: You eat hard biscuit and pastry 60% faster.
keys.{it_ladle_d}: You eat cream and ice cream 60% faster.
keys.{it_master_hand_d}: More critical bites, three times as big.
keys.{it_motor_d}: When your slice is empty, the plate turns by itself faster.
keys.{it_quick_spin_d}: The cake spins at once and the fullest neighbouring slice comes to you.
keys.{it_raccoon_fork_d}: You snatch a huge bite from the fullest slice.
keys.{it_salt_shaker_d}: The leader's slice scores half for 12 seconds.
keys.{it_smart_jaw_d}: Eating by itself never stuffs you: it slows down before you are full.
keys.{it_spoon_throw_d}: The leader can't eat for 4 seconds.
keys.{it_stamina_d}: More arm strength, and it refills faster.
keys.{it_strong_arm_d}: Each push turns the cake 30% more.
keys.{it_table_lock_d}: Nobody can turn the cake for 10 seconds.
keys.{it_turnip_juice_d}: Refills your arm strength at once.
keys.{item_useless}: That item is no use right now
keys.{line_plot_2}: The one next to me looks good
keys.{line_tired_1}: My arm is about to fall off…
keys.{over_sub_watch}: %s cakes were finished; the game lasted %s.
keys.{over_sub}: You placed #%s and ate %s of cake in total. %s cakes were finished; the game lasted %s.
keys.{robbed_sub_smaller}: A smaller slice came to you
keys.{state_empty_left}: ◀ Press A to turn it left
keys.{state_empty_right}: Press D to turn it right ▶
keys.{state_empty_tired}: Your arm is tired, wait a bit
keys.{state_stuffed_ayran}: Wait %s seconds or drink an ayran
keys.{state_threat_dog}: Your guard dog is holding on
keys.{table_line}: At the table: %s and %s bots. The cake will have %s slices.
keys.{use_ayran_sub}: Your stomach is half empty again
keys.{use_honey}: You poured honey on your slice
keys.{use_lock_sub}: Nobody can turn it for 10 seconds
